content: The use of Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) systems is particularly advantageous for older adults, especially those diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. These systems play a critical role in managing glucose variability and significantly reducing the risk of hypoglycemia. Advanced insulin delivery systems, such as automated insulin delivery (AID) devices and hybrid closed-loop systems, have demonstrated substantial efficacy in improving blood glucose management. These technologies are effective in minimizing the duration of hypoglycemic episodes and maintaining more stable glucose levels. Multiple clinical studies, including the WISDM (Wireless Innovations for Seniors with Diabetes Mellitus) and ORACL (Older Adults Receiving Automated Closed-Loop) trials, provide robust evidence supporting the effectiveness of these advanced technologies in older populations.
